en: Vintage monochrome (greenish) illustrated postcard. On the left side, there is an outdoor scene in a forest or rural setting: a woman stands near a large pot hanging over a fire while another figure sits blowing into the fire. Trees and a path are visible in the background. The right half of the card is filled with dense handwritten text in a cursive script. Additional handwriting and signatures appear at the bottom margin.
